# Which free UK tax or pay calculator do I need?

> Tick what applies to you (employee, Scottish taxpayer, landlord, contractor, director, parent, buying a home) and get the right free UK tax, pay and employment calculators from 55 tools. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
